summary: Time-bomb browser payload with drive-by download and redirect to attacker domain; self-referential dependency
details: The package's main entry (time.js) invokes iconFont() at module top level, so importing or bundling the package activates the payload. After 2026-10-01 the code launches an unbounded memory allocator and a while(true) CPU loop, overlays a canvas, and every 500ms triggers a Blob download named 'index.png.exe', opens https://admin.nikolive.cn/ in a new tab, and calls location.reload(true). Any application that bundles this library ships the time-triggered browser-side denial-of-service, the forced.exe download prompt, and the redirect to admin.nikolive.cn to its end users. In addition, package.json declares a dependency on the package's own name 'element-guci-util' at ^9.9.9, causing npm to resolve and install a separate version of the same name from the registry alongside this tarball; combined with placeholder author and repository fields, this is a dependency-confusion / additional-code-pull scaffold.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
